## MedplumClient.signInWithRedirect() method

Tries to sign in the user. Returns true if the user is signed in. This may result in navigating away to the sign in page.

**Signature:**

```typescript
signInWithRedirect(loginParams?: Partial<BaseLoginRequest>): Promise<ProfileResource | undefined>;
```
